name: When should I consider replacing my windows?
description: Replace windows if you notice drafts, condensation, operational issues, high energy bills, or visible damage like rot or cracks.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your windows if you notice drafts, condensation between panes, difficulty opening or closing them, or if your energy bills are unusually high. Visible damage like rot, cracks, or warped frames also indicates a need for replacement. Upgrading can improve comfort, efficiency, and the overall aesthetic of your home.
